subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible, session-level command that switches the active configured agent for a conversation without changing static bindings or restarting Gateway?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent contract changes routing, authorization, persistence, rollback, current-conversation binding behavior, and cross-agent isolation, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design Gated Core Command
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, state persistence, rollback/audit, static-default routing, and interaction with ACP/Codex conversation bindings.

options.title: Keep Bindings Static
options.body: Decline generic runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus approved reload/restart or existing ACP/Codex bind flows as the supported routing model.

options.title: Expose Routing Extension First
options.body: Require a generic channel/session-routing extension point before shipping a concrete `/agent` command in core.

recommendation.title: Design Gated Core Command
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, state persistence, rollback/audit, static-default routing, and interaction with ACP/Codex conversation bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history signal across multi-agent routing and current-conversation binding infrastructure.
